honesty: Every number is a model's: sizes from the config and the authored program, the chip from its published facts (cited) or its modeled unit model (labeled). Nothing here ran on an RDU; no field is a time and no throughput is claimed.

workload.source: spatial::programs::gemm_program — the canonical LOGOS matmul with deterministic fills, lifted by the tensor recognizer

sram_bytes.cite: [SN50WEB] 432 MB of on-chip SRAM; read in powers of two, as the vendor counts (1040 PMUs × 512 KB = 520 MB [DIAYN26])

hbm_bytes.cite: [SN50WEB] 64 GB of HBM2E; read in powers of two, as the vendor counts (1040 PMUs × 512 KB = 520 MB [DIAYN26])

ddr_bytes_max.cite: [SN50WEB] up to 512 GB of DDR5; read in powers of two, as the vendor counts (1040 PMUs × 512 KB = 520 MB [DIAYN26])

dies.cite: [STH26] two max reticle dies for the logic

chips_per_rack.cite: [HC26] seven integrated 800G Ethernet links make the eight-socket node's full mesh, two more 800G ports reach the inter-node fabric, ten 800G ports carry an aggregate 2 TB/s per RDU, a 400G RoCEv2 NIC scales out; [STH26] 16 RDUs in a rack, two nodes

pcu_stages.cite: not public; inherited from Plasticine [ISCA17] §3.1 — the six-stage PCU pipeline

pcu_lanes.cite: not public; inherited from Plasticine [ISCA17] Table 3 — sixteen SIMD lanes

pcu_envelope.cite: not public; the per-PCU systolic dimension is not tabulated — a 64×64 placement envelope keeps every bounded-family body placeable

datapath_bits.cite: not public; the descriptor's proof width — the PCU's own FU width is not tabulated

acc_tiles.cite: not public; the per-PCU accumulator depth is not tabulated — eight native tiles, the Tensix-class DST budget the passes were calibrated on

mesh_columns.cite: not public; the mesh aspect is not tabulated — 40 columns lay the 1040 PCUs out as 40×26

fusion_window.cite: not public; the RDU fuses a long dataflow pipeline (operator fusion, [HC26]) — 64 ops, at least a whole fused block

counter_nest.cite: not public; the counter chain's depth is not tabulated ([ISCA17]) — one counter is certain

pmu.cite: not public; inherited from Plasticine [ISCA17] Table 3 — 16 banks × 4096 words, 4 address-datapath stages; double-buffered memory units per the SN50's description [HC26]

ii_report.cycles_are: cycles of the modeled unit model (Plasticine-inherited PCU/PMU), never a measurement of the chip
